record.edic_text:
578 apoblepo {ap-ob-lep'-o}

from 575 and 991;; v

AV - have respect 1; 1

1) to turn the eyes away from other things and fix them on some one thing
   1a) to look at attentively
2) to look with steadfast mental gaze

same.cexp: 向上看；恢復視覺；看得見
看；注視；提防；考慮；留心；發覺，知道
看清楚；用力看，集中視力
顧念；小心照料，救；尊重，對…特別客氣
